keyEvents.text: Goal! León 0, Cruz Azul 1. José Paradela (Cruz Azul) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Agustín Palavecino.
Goal! León 0, Cruz Azul 2. Nicolás Ibáñez (Cruz Azul) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Carlos Rodríguez.
